## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `make quality` and relevant host tests pass.
- [ ] Firmware compiles for the affected profiles.
- [ ] Protocol response framing and subsequent commands remain correct (if affected).
- [ ] Stop behavior, pin assignments and calibration persistence were considered (if affected).
- [ ] Hardware tests and untested assumptions are stated explicitly.
- [ ] No private Wi-Fi configuration, logs, coordinates or credential-bearing binaries are included.
- [ ] Documentation and generated previews reflect user-visible changes.
